summary: Direct extraction and inspection of the rebuilt NSIS installer, confirming Voice Activity Detection's new trait impl and diagnostics field are genuinely compiled/serialized into the shipped binary, alongside every prior phase's still-unaffected symbols.
buildCommand: scripts/build-windows-whisper.sh, unchanged from Phase 5.2 (--features whisper,semantic-search) - no new native dependency was introduced this phase.

installerChecksum.sizeChangeNote: -11,407 bytes (~0.08% smaller) - within normal build-to-build variance for a small, purely additive code change (a new pure-arithmetic classification function, one new struct field, one new trait method with a single-line default); release-mode optimization/inlining decisions for such small changes can shift the final binary size in either direction without indicating a problem. No new dependency was introduced.

cipDesktopExeVerification.newSymbolsDirectProof: x86_64-w64-mingw32-nm against the extracted cip-desktop.exe finds the mangled trait-impl symbol for WhisperSpeechEngine's SpeechEngine::last_feed_was_silence, alongside the pre-existing last_feed_triggered_inference/discard_buffered_audio/required_sample_rate_hz/flush/is_ready/feed_audio impls and the run_inference/load functions (run_inference is where the VAD gate and rms_level/is_silence calls live - those two pure functions were inlined by the release-mode optimizer, as expected for small, single-call-site private functions, and are instead verified via the 4 dedicated unit tests in ai/speech/src/whisper.rs's test module, run separately under cargo test -p cip-ai-speech --features whisper). x86_64-w64-mingw32-strings finds 1 occurrence of 'silentWindowsSkipped' (the new SpeechRuntimeDiagnostics field's serde camelCase name, embedded in the binary's JSON-serialization machinery) - direct proof the new diagnostics field is genuinely compiled into this exact binary.
